description: Full CMS Care Compare profile of one nursing home by ccn (or name and state): overall, health inspection, staffing and quality measure star ratings (long-stay and short-stay) with the CMS footnote that explains a blank or 1-star rating, nurse and RN staffing hours per resident per day and weekend staffing against state and US averages, nursing staff and RN turnover, the last inspections, recent cited deficiencies with scope and severity (actual harm, immediate jeopardy), fines and payment denials of the last 3 years, abuse icon, Special Focus status, ownership, chain and the Medicare.gov link.

ccn.description: CMS Certification Number (6 characters, e.g. 475014), from nursing_home_search. Most exact.

city.description: City, to narrow a name match.

deficiencies.description: How many of the most recent cited deficiencies to list, 0 to 50. Default 10.

name.description: Facility name or part of it, if no ccn.

state.description: State as a two-letter code (VT) or name (Vermont).

name: nursing_home_ratings
title: Nursing home ratings and inspection record
